prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single close-up medieval RPG dialogue portrait, designed for a 74 by 100 pixel canvas, genuine transparent RGBA.
Input images: image 1 is identity only, preserve that named person's sex, age, hair silhouette and clothing colors. Images 2, 3, 4, 5 are Mara, Iwo, Leiya and Tore core portrait style references, not identities to copy.
Primary request: Substantially redraw this person as a closely framed large FACE portrait in the chunky hard-edged low-resolution style of images 2-5. Do not crop and magnify the old figure. Reconstruct a coherent large head with broad cheekbone and nose planes. Target only a 74x100 logical grid, large pixel clusters with 1-3 logical pixel step contour edges, a temporary palette of no more than 32 colors. No smooth shading, no decorative microtexture. No anti-alias or gradients.
Composition: 3/4 head turned toward the left as in identity reference, entire hair silhouette and visible ear intact. Head and hair occupy most of the image, chin around 82 percent height, very short neck and a very small narrow collar at the bottom, NOT a shoulder bust or long bare neck. Real empty transparent margin surrounding full silhouette: at least 3 logical pixels above hair tips, 2 left and right, 2 below the narrow collar; hair must not touch or get cut by the canvas. No frame, no shadow on background, no label, no text, no extra objects. 
Face rendering: prominent asymmetric block-shaped nose, angular cheeks, small dark deep-set eyes with barely any muted tan sclera, no bright white eye stripes, no eye gloss. Natural adult proportions, distinctive age and temperament, no chibi face, anime, handsome beautification or uniform sorrowful eyebrow template. Restrained warm skin and desaturated cloth palette, dark brown outlines rather than continuous pure black facial dividers.
Subject identity lock: Sefin, DEN-NPC-SEF, a weathered male fisherman in his mid-to-late forties, brother of Bevi. Preserve the first reference's warm sea-worn tan skin, broad heavy nose, full but short squared salt-and-pepper beard and mustache, unruly dark brown hair with obvious gray streaks at the forelock and temples, exposed right ear. Gray hair is a few broad gray masses, not dozens of individual parallel lines. Facial hair also solid angular broad shadow/light blocks, not stippling. His blue round-neck fisherman's tunic and brown collarless patched vest show only their smallest upper edge; the current card's return-registration cloth band can be a tiny dull neutral cloth edge at bottom if visible, never a decorative sash across his face.
Expression and story: steady practical fisherman with guarded sideways glance and a heavy reflective closed mouth, mature flat brows with mild asymmetry. He admits omitting his sister from a return-home list and respects her separate choices. Do not turn him into a patriarch, villain, weeping victim or smiling hero. Keep his forty-something coarse skin and middle age; do not age him into an elderly wizard.
Keep all tools, hands, fishing net, papers and record book outside this close face-only crop.
